bodyHtml:
On Saturday, October 19, the Spins took to Downtown Cohoes for the 14th Annual Mac n’ Cheese Bowl, organized by the Regional Food Bank.

A beautiful, Fall afternoon saw more than 2,000 people from around the capital region flock to Remsen St.

More than 20 local establishments participated in the competition.

Dozens of vendors and breweries also filled the street, including the bright red Spindles tent.

Spindles United was excited to donate to the cause, and host a tent to continue to educate people about the club.

As well selling merchandise, and giving away dozens of prizes.

We also hosted a small game on our turf to test people’s touches.

Overall a great event for Spindles with plenty of great conversations.

We will be back in downtown on Friday, October 25 from 6PM - 7:30PM for the Annual Trunk or Treat hosted by the Spindle City Vineyard.

We hope to see everyone in their costumes there!
